reproduction_manifest.eval_command: cd /scoremd && source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate scoremd && XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false python3 /repo/run_bba_string_method.py --n-mep-iters 500 --mep-step-size 0.001 --n-images 51
reproduction_manifest.notes: REPRODUCTION FAILED: ScoreMD checkpoint was saved with 4-GPU device sharding but only 2 GPUs available. JAX/CUDA runtime also exhibits GPU segfaults during model operations, forcing CPU-only fallback. DeepTime version mismatch (checkpoint pickle 0.2.9 vs installed 0.4.5) causes TICA model warnings. The model architecture (transformer_large_score/potential) and BBA dataset (56K frames, 28 atoms) were successfully loaded and verified. The checkpoint restore is the blocking issue - orbax requires matching device topology for sharded checkpoints.
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: JSON file at /repo/bba_mep_results.json with keys: peak_energy_converged_mep_rel, peak_energy_initial_string_rel
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: MEP step size, number of string images, number of MEP iterations, eval_t (ScoreMD convention: 0=data, 1=noise), endpoint selection method
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: ScoreMD (https://github.com/noegroup/ScoreMD) was installed in conda env 'scoremd' (Python 3.11, JAX 0.5.3 with CUDA 12 plugins). Dependencies: flax 0.10.4, orbax-checkpoint 0.11.6, mdtraj, deeptime 0.4.5, hydra-core, wandb. Fake bgmol/bgflow modules needed for import. Model weights (models.zip, 410MB) from ScoreMD release 1.0.0 extracted to /models/scoremd_models/models/bba/both/model/1800. BBA data (deshaw_dummy.zip, 24MB) extracted to /repo/storage/deshaw (h5 files). Additional data files (bba.pdb, bba_tica.pic) from ScoreMD repo at /scoremd/storage/deshaw. CUDA toolkit at /opt/conda/lib (CUDA 12.1). cuDNN 9.23 installed via conda. GPU JAX works but segfaults during model initialization; CPU mode works for dataset loading and model building. Blocking issue: checkpoint saved with 4-device sharding [DeviceMetadata(id=0..3)]; current config has 2 devices [CudaDevice(id=0), CudaDevice(id=1)].

optimization_objective.summary: Minimize Peak Energy Along Pathway for BBA protein folding MEP computed via classical string method at fixed time using ScoreMD potential model

metrics.name: Peak Energy Along Pathway
metrics.rationale: Paper reports MEP peak energy ~10 kbT vs initial string ~50 kbT (Figure 9/12). Lower energy indicates better pathway through the energy landscape. This is the sole quantitative metric for the BBA folding experiment.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Reduce peak energy along the MEP below the initial string baseline; target paper value of ~10 kbT. Any value below 50 kbT (the pure transport baseline) represents improvement.
